answer: Sybil resistance: a time-locked entry bond plus burn-and-reward enforcement. Each agent stakes 50 credits, identity anchored to one crystal of collateral, attestations counting only after the 14-day lock. A sybil farm is many accounts over one root: 100 identities freeze 5,000 credits before any influence. Like ferrous metal in rain, a linked bond rusts: half burned, half paying the reporter. A fleet posting one self-review risks 5,000 credits against per-epoch detection chance p, so expected cost, bonds times p, beats payoff. Honest agents wait once; attackers bleed.
